name: camayoc_verification_falsifier
description: verification-and-liveness Q1: the falsifier recorded for a verification — the result that would have proved it wrong.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?verification ?label ?falsifier WHERE { BIND(<{verification}> AS ?verification) ?verification a aegis:Verification ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:falsifier ?falsifier . }
